headline: Three teams enter ARC-3 gold places as three fall out

sections.text: Son & Mark & Ronen climbed from 20th to 7th at 39.24, while AFF AI CLUB rose from 29th to 9th at 38.98. Both moves put the teams among the 18 gold places.
AI_hwlee and YUTO KOJIMA fell from the gold places to 19th and 21st, respectively, as the cutoff shifted.
